Generalitat de Catalunya election information video

An animated public-information video for the 2024 Catalan parliamentary election: long-legged figures in patterned clothes stand on a globe or carry a giant highlighter.

Source
YouTube: Eleccions al Parlament de Catalunya – 12 de maig | ERTA
Creator
Generalitat de Catalunya, Departament d’Acció Exterior i Unió Europea
Made
2024
Style
Corporate Memphis (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Friendly, civic, calm
Evidence
Inspected two 1280 × 720 video frames on Wikimedia Commons: frame 1,_1.png) and frame 2,_2.png). The video itself was not watched. No image is stored.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

The Commons description (in Catalan) calls it an example of the Corporate Memphis style used by the Generalitat de Catalunya in general videos in 2024, and gives the YouTube video as the source. Wikimedia Commons,_1.png).

Wikipedia notes that by 2023 the style was spreading from tech to other sectors while its popularity fell. Wikipedia.

Observed

  • Frame 1: four figures stand around the curve of a dark plum globe on a flat peach background. Their bodies are tall and thin with small heads and small feet.
  • Their clothes have dot, check, and stripe patterns in pink and plum; every shape has a thin dark outline.
  • A red label reads “VOT EXTERIOR ERTA” and a subtitle runs along the bottom.
  • Frame 2: on flat pink, a woman in a beret and striped wide trousers holds a highlighter as long as her torso next to a desk calendar showing “maig 2”.

Why it belongs

It shows the style after its tech years: adopted by government communication, with outline and pattern added. The oversized object and the long thin figure remain; the non-natural skin and flat unoutlined fills are gone.

Borrow

Put the key fact (a date, a place) on an oversized object that the figure holds or points to.
